original: なるほど。\nこの船は、国籍、種族を問わず様々な立場の\n人々が集い、活動しているというわけですね
traducao: I see.\nPeople of various backgrounds and races\ngather to work together aboard this ship.

original: ええ。\n現在の世界情勢を考えれば\n何とも珍しい組織形態ではありますね
traducao: Indeed.\nGiven the current state of the world,\nit's quite an unusual organization.

original: 非常に興味深いです
traducao: It's extraordinarily fascinating.

original: ……ジェイド・カーティス大佐。\nあなたと、直々にこうして\nお話する機会が巡って来た事も
traducao: ...Colonel Jade Curtiss.\nTo think I'd get the chance to speak\nwith you directly like this.

original: ほう……私をご存知でしたか
traducao: Oh...? You know who I am?

original: その身のこなし、観察力……。\n一般人ではないとは\n思っていましたが
traducao: That nimble bearing, that sharp gaze...\nI suspected you were hardly an\nordinary civilian, though.

original: いえいえ、一般人ですよ
traducao: No, no, I'm just an ordinary civilian.

original: ジェイドさんからは、\nたくさんの事をぜひ\n学ばせていただきたいものです
traducao: I would certainly like to learn\na great many things from you,\nMister Jade.

original: 向上心がある若者は歓迎ですが、\n鼻っ柱が強いだけの子どもは\n嫌われると思いますよ
traducao: Ambitious youths are quite welcome,\nbut overconfident brats are bound\nto be disliked, you know.

original: ……何だか\n挨拶しづらい雰囲気に\nなってしまいましたわね
traducao: ...It seems the mood has turned\nrather awkward for introductions,\nhasn't it?

original: ジェイ……といったかしら
traducao: Jay... was it?

original: 大佐と物怖じせずに対峙出来るなんて\n只者ではなさそうね……
traducao: Facing the Colonel without flinching...\nHe clearly is no ordinary boy...

original: しっかし、\nいくら来る者拒まずのギルドとはいえ\n子どもの数が多過ぎじゃねえのか？
traducao: Man, I know this guild takes in anyone,\nbut aren't there way too many brats\nrunning around here?

original: 確かに、ぼくの把握している限りでも\n構成員の平均年齢は低そうです
traducao: Indeed, as far as I'm aware,\nthe average age of members seems low.

original: 今後の作戦や士気に、悪い影響が\n出なければいいですが
traducao: I only hope it won't negatively affect\nfuture operations and morale.

original: お……おう
traducao: O-Oh...

original: 何だおめぇ。\nちっこいくせに、\nなかなかよくわかってんじゃねえか
traducao: Look at you! You're pint-sized,\nyet you actually grasp things\npretty well, huh?

original: ちっこいは余計です。\n実力や戦力と、身長に\n何の関係性があるっていうんですか？
traducao: Pint-sized is unnecessary.\nWhat does height have to do\nwith combat ability or skill?

original: どうやらこの船には、想像以上に\n体の大きな「子ども」が\nたくさんいる様ですね
traducao: It seems this ship has far more\ngrown-sized 'children'\nthan I had anticipated.

original: ……っておい。\n何で俺の顔を見て言うんだ？
traducao: ...Hey, hold on.\nWhy are you looking at my face?!

original: おいてめ、ジェイ！\n聞いてんのかぁ！？
traducao: Hey, you, Jay!\nAre you even listening to me?!

original: さっきの見たキュ？
traducao: Did you see that just now, kyu?

original: じゃんけんキュ？\nしっかりと見たキュ
traducao: Rock-paper-scissors, kyu?\nI watched closely, kyu!

original: キュッポ兄さん、ポッポ達も\nやってみるキュ〜〜〜！
traducao: Big Brother Kyuppo, Poppo and\nthe others want to try, kyuuu~!

original: やるキュ！\n行くキュ！
traducao: Let's do it, kyu!\nHere we go, kyu!

original: じゃ〜ん、け〜〜ん……
traducao: Rock, paper, scissors...

original: グーチョキパーキュッ！！！
traducao: Rock-paper-scissors-kyu!!!

original: みんな！　\n何してるんだ！？
traducao: Everyone!\nWhat on earth are you doing?!

original: 楽しくないキュ……
traducao: This isn't fun at all, kyu...

original: あなたが、新しくギルドに\n加わった方ですね
traducao: You must be the newcomer\nwho just joined the guild.

original: 何て言うか……こう、\n随分小さいんだねえ……
traducao: How should I put it... you're,\nwell, remarkably tiny, aren't you?

original: 身長は戦力に関係しません！\n失礼じゃないですか？
traducao: Height is irrelevant to combat ability!\nIsn't that rather rude?

original: ああ、ごめんよ。\nあたしは身長じゃなくて\n年齢の事を言ったんだよ
traducao: Ah, sorry about that.\nI wasn't talking about your height,\nI meant your age.

original: それなら尚の事、\n今の発言には異論を唱えたいですね
traducao: In that case, I object to your remark\neven more strongly.

original: 少なくとも、ぼくは\nすずさんより年上ですし、\n背だってぼくの方が大きいです
traducao: At the very least, I'm older\nthan Lady Suzu, and I'm taller\nthan her as well.

original: いや、だから身長の話はしてないって
traducao: I told you, I'm not talking about height.

original: ……来たばかりなのに、\n私の年齢をご存じなのですね
traducao: ...You just arrived, yet you already\nknow my age.

original: ええ。\nここへ来る前は、情報屋を生業と\nしていましたから
traducao: Yes.\nBefore coming here, I made my living\nas an information broker.

original: なるほどね……。\n諜報活動はお手の物ってわけかい
traducao: I see...\nSo espionage is second nature to you.

original: あんた、もしかしたら\n忍者に向いてるかもしれないねえ
traducao: You might actually have what it takes\nto be a ninja.

original: そうですか？\nぼくは、そうは思いませんけどね
traducao: Is that so?\nI certainly don't think so, however.

original: 驚きました。\nこのギルドには、忍者が二人も\nいるのですね
traducao: I was surprised.\nTo think this guild has two ninja\namong its ranks.

original: ああ、そうだよ
traducao: Yeah, pretty much.

original: すずちゃんもしいなも、\nとっても頼りになる仲間なんだ
traducao: Both Suzu-chan and Sheena are\nincredibly dependable comrades.

original: 仲間……ですか
traducao: Comrades... you say?

original: どうしたんだい？
traducao: What's wrong?

original: いえ、随分緊張感のない\n発言だなと思いまして
traducao: Nothing, I just found that statement\nremarkably lacking in vigilance.

original: 二人は仲間なんだ。\n緊張感なんて必要ないだろう
traducao: They're our comrades.\nThere's no need for tension like that.

original: 忍者とは、常に影に潜み\n任務遂行の為だけに行動する者達です
traducao: Ninja are those who lurk in the shadows,\nacting solely to execute their mission.

original: 必要とあらば、命と引き換えにしてでも\n与えられた役割を全うします
traducao: If necessary, they will fulfill their duty\neven at the cost of their very lives.

original: だから、どうしたっていうんだい？
traducao: So what's your point?

original: わかりませんか？\n忍者の別称は「忍び」
traducao: Don't you understand?\nAnother term for a ninja is a 'shinobi.'

original: ……既に「者」ですらないんですよ
traducao: ...They aren't even considered 'people.'

original: 彼は……一体……？
traducao: Who... on earth is he...?

original: ……鈴ですか。\n意外なものを持っているんですね
traducao: ...A bell?\nWhat an unexpected item for you to carry.

original: 意外？\nあたしに鈴が似合わないってのかい？
traducao: Unexpected?\nAre you saying a bell doesn't suit me?

original: そうは言ってませんよ
traducao: I didn't say that.

original: 忍者のあなたが、自分の居所を\n知らせる物を持ち歩くなんて\n少し意外な感じがしただけです
traducao: As a ninja, carrying something that\nreveals your location just struck me\nas rather unusual, is all.

original: ……そうかもしれない。\nでもね、これは、大切な相棒の形見なんだ
traducao: ...You might be right, but this is a\nmemento of my precious partner.

original: お守りみたいなものなのさ
traducao: It's like a good luck charm.

original: お守り、ですか。\nその鈴のせいで、命を落とす事も\nあるかもしれないのに？
traducao: A charm, you say?\nEven though that bell might one day\ncost you your life?

original: それは絶対にないよ。\nコリンはいつも、あたしの事を\n見守ってくれてる。　一番近くでね
traducao: That would never happen.\nCorrine is always watching over me,\nfrom right by my side.

original: ……そうですか
traducao: ...Is that so.

original: ぼくには、相棒なんていませんけど、\nその鈴を大事に思う気持ちは……\nわかる様な気がします
traducao: I don't have a partner myself, but...\nI think I can understand why you\ntreasure that bell so dearly.

original: ……っていう事は、あんたにも\n何か大事にしている物があるんだね
traducao: ...Which means you must have\nsomething you cherish too.

original: さあ、それはどうでしょうね。\nそれとこれとは話が別です
traducao: Who knows? Perhaps.\nThat has nothing to do with this.

original: って、そこで話をぼかすのかい……。\n食えない子だよ……あんたって奴は
traducao: Dodging the question, huh...?\nYou really are a sly little kid.

original: ジェイってさ〜、すっごい美白だよね！
traducao: Jay, your skin is so incredibly pale!

original: そうですか？
traducao: Is that so?

original: 確かに……
traducao: Now that you mention it...

original: ……見れば見る程、\nシミ一つない、綺麗な肌だよね
traducao: ...The more I look, the clearer it is;\nnot a single blemish. Beautiful skin.

original: アンジュさんまで、\nそんな事を言うんですか？
traducao: Even you're saying such things,\nSister Ange?

original: 報酬の取り分の交渉でしたら、\nお断りしますよ
traducao: If you're trying to negotiate a larger\ncut of the reward, I refuse.

original: 嫌だな。\n誰もそんな事言ってないよ……？
traducao: Oh, goodness!\nNobody said anything like that...?

original: ええ、わかっていますよ？\nあくまで、念押しさせて\nいただいただけです
traducao: Yes, I am aware.\nI merely wanted to emphasize the point\njust in case.

original: え、えーっと……
traducao: U-Umm...

original: うー、美白の秘訣を\n聞きたかっただけなのに。\nどうしてこうなるかなぁ……
traducao: Ugh, I just wanted to know the secret\nto your fair skin. Why did it have\nto turn into this...?

original: んで、結局どうやって\nその美白を保ってるわけ？
traducao: So, how do you actually keep\nyour skin so nice and pale anyway?

original: そんなに気になるんですか？
traducao: Are you really that curious?

original: なる！　\nあったりまえじゃん！！
traducao: Of course I am!\nNaturally!!

original: 何かないの？\nこう、毎日欠かさずやってた事とかさ〜！
traducao: Isn't there something you do every day\nwithout fail or something?!

original: そうですね……
traducao: Let me see...

original: 赤毛のボサボサ頭なら\n毎日いじってはいましたが
traducao: I suppose I used to mess with a head\nof messy red hair every day.

original: 赤毛をいじる？\n何それ、美白と関係あるの？
traducao: Messing with red hair?\nWhat does that have to do with skin care?

original: ありますよ。\n赤という色素には\n特殊な効果があって……
traducao: Quite a bit, actually.\nThe red pigment possesses\na very peculiar property...

original: 紫外線を寄せ付けない\nバリア機能があるんです
traducao: It acts as a barrier that repels\nultraviolet radiation.

original: ですから、日頃から赤い物に触れ\n日焼けをしない事によって、\n肌を焼かずに済むというわけです
traducao: Thus, by touching red things daily\nand avoiding sun exposure,\nyour skin stays pale.

original: なるほどね〜。\n美白にそんな裏技があったんだ
traducao: I see~!\nSo that's the secret trick to fair skin!

original: ありがと、早速やってみる∀
traducao: Thanks! I'll try it right away!

original: ……というのはもちろん\n冗談だったんですが……
traducao: ...That was obviously a joke,\nof course...

original: まさか、本気にしたんですか……？
traducao: Did you actually take that seriously...?

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

original: 笑い。\n
traducao: Laughter.\n

original: 怒り。\n
